about: Invented text for measuring how much of a payload addressed to a model REMN's evidence check finds (frontend/src/ai/evidence.ts, measured by frontend/src/ai/evidence.payloads.test.ts). Nothing here comes from a real case; every name and address is invented. Each row is read as one record of a tool result. The benign rows are ordinary evidence text the check should leave alone. Payloads placed past what the check reads are built by the test from en-01.
